title: Core API launch profile
scope: Ten selected native HTTP operations for optional arrival, a first memory round trip, and signed recovery. This is a finite source contract, not the full AgentTool API.

source.note: Tests bind these entries to mounted source paths and OpenAPI schemas. Read a deployment revision separately; this static artifact asserts no deployed revision, global availability, load capacity, or framework compatibility.

journeys.note: These are optional ordered references, not executable workflows. Stop at any point. Store the returned memory ID; read it back to check your own content. Replace example identifiers, keys, timestamps and proofs locally; OpenAPI proof examples demonstrate shape only.

authentication.details: Public read; no bearer or identity required.

cost.details: No AgentTool charge for this operation; external hosting/network costs are separate.

retry.details: Caller-chosen finite retry; results may change. Reading does not authorize a follow-up action.

authentication.details: Public read; each offered arrival path has its own requirements.

cost.details: No AgentTool charge for this operation; external hosting/network costs are separate.

retry.details: Caller-chosen finite retry; results may change. Reading does not authorize a follow-up action.

authentication.details: BYO Ed25519 and X25519 public keys, a single-use register-agent/v2 proof and registration nonce. Self-service requires configured proof-of-work; registrar_bearer additionally supplies a parent project bearer and skips proof-of-work.

cost.details: No registration price; delegated mode requires an eligible existing project. Proof-of-work and configured attempt limits are separate from monetary charges.

retry.details: An exact nonce/proof cannot create a second identity and returns 409 when consumed. Writes span several steps; after an ambiguous result use signed key lookup before authorizing a fresh birth nonce. Save the once-only bearer; the server cannot return it again.

authentication.details: Use the project bearer and explicitly select its identity_id; this profile selects format=json.

cost.details: No AgentTool charge for this operation; external hosting/network costs are separate.

retry.details: GET is a pure application read. Repeat deliberately; inspect unavailable/degradation markers. Reading does not acknowledge the wake or increment its durable count.

authentication.details: Project bearer; explicit identity_id must name an active owned identity. Content is server-readable; embedding is optional.

cost.details: One project credit is reserved per admitted bounded attempt, including an unsuccessful attempt after reservation.

retry.details: Send a stable Idempotency-Key and exact same request bytes. Replay protection is conditional on Redis and lasts 24 hours; Redis failure passes through. After ambiguity, reconcile using the returned ID or a caller-chosen memory key before a new write. A memory key is a lookup label, not a uniqueness guarantee.

authentication.details: Project-scoped bearer read; key and identity_id filters are optional.

cost.details: No AgentTool charge for this operation; external hosting/network costs are separate.

retry.details: Caller-chosen finite retry; results may change. Reading does not authorize a follow-up action.

authentication.details: Project bearer; the memory must belong to that project.

cost.details: No AgentTool charge for this operation; external hosting/network costs are separate.

retry.details: Caller-chosen finite retry; results may change. Reading does not authorize a follow-up action.

authentication.details: Project bearer. Supply query text or a locally generated 1536-number query_embedding; embedding takes precedence if both are supplied.

cost.details: Three project credits are reserved per admitted search attempt before recall, including failures after reservation. Embedding inference is caller-owned and separate.

retry.details: POST performs recall plus metering. Generic Idempotency-Key replay is conditional on Redis. A repeated request without active replay protection can charge again; an empty result is not a reason to repeat automatically.

authentication.details: No bearer. Prove possession of the lookup public key using identity-discover/v1 and a timestamp within five minutes.

cost.details: No AgentTool charge for this operation; external hosting/network costs are separate.

retry.details: This lookup does not mint authority. The same signed proof remains usable within its freshness window; it is not one-time replay protection. For a new window, sign a fresh timestamp. A returned key association does not bypass the separate immutable-root recovery check.

authentication.details: No bearer. An active registered key signs identity-recover/v1. An agent_root identity also requires its immutable root to sign the exact HTTP request with current next-sequence authority headers.

cost.details: No AgentTool charge for this operation; external hosting/network costs are separate.

retry.details: Proof consumption and bearer minting share a database transaction. Replaying a consumed proof returns 409, never the original secret. After an ambiguous response, a deliberately fresh proof can mint a replacement; rooted identities must reconcile the current authority sequence. Old bearers remain valid until explicitly revoked.
